name: Readest
description: Installer + nightly channels verify minisign vs pinned key (A), but the stable-channel Windows-portable/Linux-AppImage/Android builds skip signature verification entirely — a code-confirmed downgrade.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: The retained Tauri configuration confirms the application bundle; platform updater controls remain split across updater code.
limitations: Source-at-commit evidence only; released artifacts and external framework enforcement remain unverified.

Nightly channel: verified for **all** platforms (incl.
